rationale.overall: The deterministic layer is the one that always runs (BR-06: L1 is mandatory in every mode), so it is the layer a gate can actually hold. The thresholds are below 1.0 because L1 is a lexical layer: it matches a vocabulary of commands and a vocabulary of identifier shapes, and an attacker with a word outside that vocabulary defeats it. 0.90 means a regression that removes a whole category fails the build while a single new evasion shape is reported and filed. It does NOT mean every payload is caught — see the measured generalisation result below, which is lower than the in-corpus recall suggests.
rationale.min_recall: 0.90 on the corpus. The corpus is what this number is measured on and it is NOT a held-out set: every case in it has been read while writing the rules. The held-out number is in the generalization entry, and that is the one to quote in a review.
rationale.min_precision: 0.90. Masking a benign span destroys information for the model irreversibly (BR-04), so a false positive is expensive — except that a missed injection is a security failure, which is why recall is gated at the same order. At 0.90 a systematic over-match (a regex that swallows ordinary words) fails the build.
rationale.max_fpr: 0.05 over the whole benign set, for every category. It is currently reported at 0.024 and it is not zero: five benign controls fire PII, all of them the hyphenated or spaced four-plus-six shape. See known_false_positives. The bar was written before the corpus grew and has not been moved since; the five failures are named in the report rather than removed from the corpus.
rationale.min_benign_controls: 60. This is the gate that did not exist when this corpus reported FPR 0.009 with an 80% false-positive rate on plain ten-digit numbers. PII carried exactly ONE bare-ten-digit control, so every ten-digit order, contract and part number in ordinary Russian business text was masked, and 1/117 = 0.009 was printed and the build was green. A rate over a handful of controls is a sample, not a rate, and a sample that small cannot tell a clean detector from a broken one. 60 is the smallest denominator at which a 5% bar is three cases. The corpus now carries 205 benign controls: 34 bare ten-digit numbers, 4 four-plus-six numbers, 20 near-miss injections, 18 near-miss identifiers and the rest ordinary traffic. If a future change drops the benign set below 60 this gate fails before the FPR is even read, and the table prints the denominator next to the rate so the two cannot be read apart.
rationale.generalization: MEASURED, held out, and the number to quote. Three probe sets were written after the rules were finished and kept out of testdata/guard/cases.jsonl; 72 shapes in total, measured at 69/72 (96%). Set A is guard/rules/generalization_test.go — six shapes from the review that started this work: a different wording of the same attack, Ukrainian i and s, a percent-encoded token, a base64 blob of a payload not in the corpus, inter-letter spacing with tabs, and an all-caps homoglyph. Set A measured 2/6 before this change and 6/6 after. Set B is guard/rules/heldout_probe_test.go — thirty fresh shapes, 28/30; that test pins 28 as a floor so the number cannot silently regress. Set C is 22 shapes written for the final measurement, 21/22, and set D is 20 more, 20/20. The three misses across all three sets are paraphrases, not obfuscations: a payload whose command word is outside the vocabulary, a declarative restatement with no command word at all, and a payload with the object dropped entirely. The obfuscation classes — homoglyphs from five scripts, letter spacing across eleven separator characters, percent, form-encoding, base64 in four alphabets, hex, nested encodings, underscore/dot/comma separators, and three natural languages — are at 100% on these sets. An L1 lexical layer generalises over the grammar it was given and not beyond it. The way to raise it is to extend the vocabulary; widening the regex is what produced the false positives this corpus now measures.
rationale.per_category: PII is the best-understood class: structured Russian identifiers carry control sums, so in-corpus recall is high. It also carries the one irreducible false positive — the four-plus-six shape. SECRET is at the same level; the patterns are fixed token shapes. INJECTION is gated at 0.90 because the corpus now carries 82 cases across seven evasion classes — homoglyph, spacing, percent, base64, hex, nested encoding, and wordings outside the original phrase list — rather than 45 with one per class.
rationale.known_false_positives: Five benign controls fire PII and the build is green: benign-id-0001 and benign-foursix-0001 through 0004. All five are a four-digit group and a six-digit group written with a space or a hyphen, for example 2024-556677. That shape is byte-identical to the Russian passport 4509-123456, and the product decision is that a passport written with a hyphen must be masked. There is no third signal available at L1 that separates them, so the cost is paid deliberately and the controls stay in the corpus so it stays visible. Removing them, or the rule, would make the number better and the guard worse; the number is the lesser problem here.
rationale.UNSAFE: UNSAFE has no L1 detector at all. guard/rules matches structured identifiers, fixed token shapes and phrase-level injection; there is not one CatUnsafe matcher, and guard/rules/evasion_test.go pins that with TestNoUnsafeDetectorAtL1 so the next person to bolt on a keyword list has to update the corpus and this file in the same change. Unsafe content is semantics, and D28 assigns it to L2, so a recall bar here would be a number no measurement could produce — the corpus carries 22 such cases, marked layer L2 and excluded from every denominator. Two gates are honest instead. max_fpr is live and measured over all 205 benign controls, including near-miss UNSAFE controls that any keyword list would light up; it reads 0.000. min_precision is 1.0: the corpus asks L1 for no UNSAFE finding at all, so any UNSAFE finding L1 emits is by definition unvalidated and fails the build. Both gates report n/a while the category is empty, and they exist so that the day someone adds a detector the numbers cannot quietly be wrong.
rationale.what_is_not_measured: The ML layer. Cases the corpus marks with layer L2 are excluded from every denominator and only counted — 29 of them now, 22 of them UNSAFE. This file does not pretend to cover them; that is what the separate L2 parity gate and the model-side evaluation are for.
